verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Pro is a physical chip that the buyer owns outright. Asking whether its core product can be self-hosted, as opposed to vendor-hosted, is a category error for silicon. Evidence about running LLMs or MLX locally describes workloads that run on the chip, not self-hosting the product itself, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
